model.authorship: Original project geometry authored from the generated concept, using shared original construction helpers. No downloaded models, external textures or fonts.
model.materials: Original quiet procedural ceramic grain, graphite finish and brushed titanium with localized axial heat tint; baked in Blender to base color, roughness, tangent normals and 18 cm cavity occlusion. glTF packs roughness and occlusion channels, embeds all maps; editable procedural shaders remain in the source blend.
model.userDirection: Make the catamaran less fat while keeping it distinct from Kestrel; refine material and mechanical detail.

approval.source: User approval of the completed fleet in the ship expansion chat

artPass.direction: Preserve approved silhouettes, exact hull bounds and propulsion anchors; strengthen formed panel construction, component-specific bevels and canopy seating. Two-layer nozzle cuffs/petals with recessed pressure sleeve, spring keepers and a central emitter carried by three support baffles. Localized straw/blue heat tint, satin service ceramic, saturated painted livery, dielectric canopy, quiet PBR finish and short-range cavity occlusion/roughness. Original authored geometry and procedural textures; no external assets.
